public.review_route_enlist_member(p_org.reason: A review route's member task joins its route, at send or when a reviewer is added (RR1a, RR2; P-59). Owned by review_route_writer, a NOLOGIN, NOINHERIT role with no attributes that the runtime role is not a member of; unified_tasks_route_rows_guard admits a review route member's write only when current_user is that role (P-59, migrations/20261023_review_routes.sql amended in place 2026-10-29), so a route row changes only through these doors and never through a session setting (the c2c.review_route_writer setting the runtime role could set itself is no longer read). search_path is pinned to pg_catalog, public. It cannot cross a tenant: with RLS enforcing, the body refuses unless app.current_tenant_id equals the organization argument (review_route_door_scope), and every statement it runs carries organization_id = p_org; the role is subject to the tenant policies like the runtime role. Called only by server/services/review/review-route.ts (and, for the reassignment, task-assignment.ts on its behalf), on the request's tenant-scoped transaction.
